body: Residual from T-87 (disclosed in its review): SettingsViewModel updateCurrency() resends _uiState.value.initials, which is a literal "" when the best-effort loadInitials() has not resolved (e.g. offline start) — a present "" is a valid value and overwrites a real override server-side. Now that the server treats an ABSENT initials key as leave-unchanged (T-87), the fix is to omit initials from UpdateSettingsRequest on currency-only saves (kotlinx Json with default null + encodeDefaults=false omits the key — verify the configured Json instance actually omits it on the wire in a test). Also update the comment at SettingsViewModel.kt:32-35. Ships with the next APK release. Files: android .../ui/settings/SettingsViewModel.kt, .../data/api/Dto.kt if needed, SettingsViewModelTest.
title: Android: currency save can still clobber initials when the preload failed — omit the initials key
